description: Preview and persist apikey*.txt credentials into local/global .env. Preview-first: the default call verifies and projects the target and returns a plan_handle; call again with execute=true and that handle to persist. overwrite=false appends different credentials as another connection.

execute.description: Persist the reviewed preview (default false = preview only, writes nothing).

file_path.description: Absolute path to apikey*.txt; defaults to the only secure apikey*.txt in cwd.

overwrite.description: Replace the default stored connection instead of appending. Default false.

plan_handle.description: Plan handle returned by the reviewed preview. Required for execute=true.

profile.description: Optional tool profile stored in the selected local/global .env.

storage_scope.description: local = this folder; global = any folder. Omit for interactive choice when supported.

name: import_apikey_credentials
title: Import API Key Credentials
